title: Scheduled sessions' private-monorepo clone is refused by the permission classifier about 2 times in 3; runs re-plan slowly and crowd one public guide
problem: add_repo attaches private-monorepo, then the session's permission classifier refuses the git clone. Runs then retried, asked what 'can reach' meant, or picked the same public fallback (pay-app-guides), so four parallel PRs conflicted on its shared lists. Nothing said a refusal is final or what to do next, and the owner had no row asking for the one setting that removes the step.
evidence: prompts/runs/2026-11-25-*.json: 42 records mention private-monorepo; 28 say the clone was refused, denied or blocked; 14 shipped a private PR
platform/ci/friction_rank.py --live --ungated --days 3 (2026-11-25): #3 prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md 7x, #9 portfolio/flagships.yaml 3x, both this cause
change: cloud-session.md: a refused clone is final, no retry or workaround, go to the public side and search open PRs on the guide's slug first. ventures/prompt-1.md 'can reach' -> 'can clone'. allocate.py's flagship hint says the same. asks.yaml row private-monorepo-clone asks the owner to add the repo as a source of the routine's environment.
metric: run records per day whose doc_friction asks what to do after a refused private-monorepo clone (friction_rank cluster size), and records with a refused clone that still retried
baseline: 7 distinct sessions on prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md + 3 on flagships.yaml in the 3 days to 2026-11-25 (friction_rank.py)
